pr_body:
- Move static feature set and number system `StringName`s to the singleton instance to avoid orphan `StringName`s.
- Remove `hb_` prefix from the custom bitmap font functions to avoid potential conflicts with the HarfBuzz.
- Cleanup commented debug code from MSDF font implementation.
- Update numbering system data to CLDR 39.

Fixes #53688
